origin.description: Pairwise string distances. The shorter argument is recycled.
origin.usage: stringdist(a, b, method = c("osa", "lv", "dl", "hamming", "lcs", "qgram", "cosine", "jaccard", "jw", "soundex"), useBytes = FALSE, weight = c(d = 1, i = 1, s = 1, t = 1), q = 1, p = 0, bt = 0, nthread = getOption("sd_num_thread"))

arguments.name: b
arguments.text: Source. Converted with as.character. The shorter of a and b is recycled.

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: osa, lv, dl, hamming, lcs, qgram, cosine, jaccard, jw, or soundex. A unique prefix is accepted. The default is osa.

arguments.name: useBytes
arguments.text: Compare UTF-8 bytes instead of characters.

arguments.name: weight
arguments.text: Positive weights no larger than 1. For osa and dl: deletion, insertion, substitution, transposition. For lv the transposition weight is ignored. For jw: weight of characters in a, characters in b, and transpositions.

arguments.name: q
arguments.text: q-gram size. Used by qgram, cosine, and jaccard. Truncated toward zero.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Jaro-Winkler prefix factor, from 0 to 0.25. Zero returns the Jaro distance.

arguments.name: bt
arguments.text: Winkler boost is applied only when the Jaro distance is greater than bt.

origin.details: A missing string makes that pair missing. Hamming distance is infinite when the lengths differ. Cosine distance is NaN when only one string has a q-gram. Both strings shorter than q have distance 0.
origin.example: stringdist("ca", "abc") returns 3. stringdist("ca", "abc", method = "dl") returns 2. stringdist("ab", "abc", method = "h") returns Inf. stringdist("Euler", "Ellery", method = "soundex") returns 0.

translation.description: Pairwise string distances. The shorter argument is recycled.
translation.usage: stringdist(a, b, method=None, useBytes=False, weight=(1, 1, 1, 1), q=1, p=0, bt=0, nthread=1)

arguments.name: a
arguments.text: Target string, or a list of strings. None is a missing string. An empty list has length zero.

arguments.name: b
arguments.text: Source string, or a list of strings. The shorter argument is recycled.

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: osa, lv, dl, hamming, lcs, qgram, cosine, jaccard, jw, or soundex. A unique prefix is accepted. Omitted means osa.

arguments.name: useBytes
arguments.text: Compare UTF-8 bytes instead of characters.

arguments.name: weight
arguments.text: Positive weights no larger than 1, in positional order. For jw the first three are the weight of a, the weight of b, and transpositions.

arguments.name: q
arguments.text: q-gram size for qgram, cosine, and jaccard. Truncated toward zero.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Jaro-Winkler prefix factor, from 0 to 0.25. Zero returns the Jaro distance.

arguments.name: bt
arguments.text: Winkler boost is applied only when the Jaro distance is greater than bt.

arguments.name: nthread
arguments.text: Checked and unused. The distance runs in one thread.

translation.details: None makes that pair missing. Hamming distance is infinite when the lengths differ. Cosine distance is NaN when only one string has a q-gram. Both strings shorter than q have distance 0.
translation.value: A list with one distance per recycled pair. None is a missing distance.
translation.example: stringdist("ca", "abc") returns 3. stringdist("ca", "abc", method="dl") returns 2. stringdist("ab", "abc", method="h") returns Inf. stringdist("Euler", "Ellery", method="soundex") returns 0.
